content.text: I swɑɑ dɑkio.
Bwisi yi ɡbɑ̃rɑmɔ, yɛ̃ru tɑ nɔɔɡiru sue.
Yi yɔ̃ ɡunɡunu wɔllɔ swɑɑ bɑɑrɔ kɑ swɑɑ kɛɛnɑnɔ.
Yi ɡbɑ̃rɑmɔ ɡɑmbon bɔkuɔ wuun duu yerɔ
mi bɑ rɑ siribu ko, yi mɔ̀,
bɛɛ tɔmbu, bɛɛyɑ nɑ soku,
tɔn bibu kpurowɑ nɑ kɑ mɔ̀.
Lɑɑkɑri sɑribɑ, i de i n lɑɑkɑri mɔ.
Gɑri bɑkɑsu, i bwisi koowo.
I swɑɑ dɑkio, kon bɛɛ ɡɑri bɛɛrɛɡii sɔ̃.
Ye kon ɡere kpuro yɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ dee dee.
Domi nɑ ku rɑ weesu ɡere, nɑ kɔ̃sɑ tusɑ.
Nɛn ɡɑri kpuro sɑ̃ɑwɑ ɡem,
weesu kɑ tɑki sɑri yi sɔɔ.
Yi kpuro yi bururewɑ kpɑsɑsɑ bwisiɡiin mi.
Mɛyɑ yi mɑɑ dɛɛre wi u yɛ̃ru mɔn mi.
I nɛn sɔ̃ɔsiru mɔɔ n kere sii ɡeesu,
kpɑ i mɑɑ yɛ̃ru mwɑ n kere wurɑn tii.
Domi bwisi yi bɛɛrɛ mɔ yɑ kpɑ̃
yɑ burɑ yɑ̃nu kpuro kere.
Ye bɑ rɑ kɑsu kpuro sɔɔ,
ɡɑ̃ɑnu sɑri ni kɑɑ kɑ yi weesinɑ.
Nɛ bwisi, nɑ rɑ ɡɑrin ɑsɑnsi tubu.
Nɑ yɛ̃ru mɔ n kɑ ɡɑ̃ɑnu wunɑnɑ.
À n kĩ ɑ Yinni Gusunɔ bɛɛrɛ wɛ̃, ɑ de ɑ kɔ̃sɑ tusi.
Nɑ tii suɑbu kɑ yɛ̃kɔ
kɑ kɔ̃sɑn kookoosu kɑ keetɑn ɡɑri tusɑ.
Nɑ rɑ tɔnu bwisi kɛ̃, kpɑ n nùn lɑɑkɑri wɛ̃.
Nɛnɑ nɑ yɛ̃ru, nɛnɑ mɑɑ dɑm.
Nɛn sɑɑbuwɑ sinɑmbɑ kɑ bɑndu nɛni,
mɑ wiruɡibɑ woodɑ wɛ̃ɛmɔ ye yɑ dee dee sɑ̃ɑ.
Nɛn somirun sɑɑbuwɑ sinɑmbu kɑ wiruɡibu
kɑ siri kowobu kpuro bɑ kɑ tem nɛni.
Be bɑ mɑn kĩ, nɑ mɑɑ bu kĩ.
Be bɑ mɑn kɑsu, bɑ koo mɑn wɑ.
Arumɑni kɑ bɛɛrɛwɑ nɑ tɔnu wɛ̃ɛmɔ
kɑ mɑɑ dukiɑ ye yɑ ku rɑ sɑnkire.
Kon de ye tɔnu mɔ kpuro yɑ n dɑ wɛ̃re.
Nɛn ɑre yi sii ɡeesu kɑ wurɑn tii bɛɛrɛ kere.
Nɑ sĩimɔwɑ swɛɛ yì sɔɔ ɡem kɑ kookoo ɡeesu wɑ̃ɑ.
Nɑ be bɑ mɑn kĩ ɑrumɑni wɛ̃ɛmɔ
mɑ nɑ dukiɑ yibiɑmɔ ben beru yerɔ.
Yinni Gusunɔ u mɑn mɑrɑ u sere ɡɑ̃ɑnu kpuro tɑkɑ kuɑ.
Bɑ mɑn ɡɔsɑ bɑ yi yellun di n tɛ
bɑ sere hɑnduniɑ tɑkɑ kuɑ.
Bɑ mɑn mɑrɑ bɑ sere nim wɔ̃ku kuɑ,
sɑnɑm mɛ nim bweru sɑri.
Bɑ mɑn mɑrɑ bɑ sere ɡuunu kɑ ɡunɡunu swĩi.
Sɑnɑm mɛ, Gusunɔ kun ɡinɑ tem tɛrie kɑ mɛn ɡbeɑ.
Bɑɑ tuɑ, u ǹ mɑm kue.
Sɑɑ ye u wɔllu tɛriɑmɔ
kɑ nim wɔ̃kun bubenu,
nɑ wɑ̃ mi.
Sɑnɑm mɛ u ɡuru winu doke wɔllɔ,
mɑ nim mu kurɑ tem di mu tɛriɑ,
nɑ wɑ̃ɑ mi.
Sɑnɑm mɛ u nim wɔ̃kun nim yɔ̃rɑ yeru sɔ̃ɔsi
u nɛɛ, mu ku tu sɑrɑ,
mɑ u tem tɑ̃sisiɑ,
nɑ wɑ̃ɑ win bɔkuɔ sɑ sɔmburu mɔ̀.
Win nuku dobu wɑ̃ɑ nɛ sɔɔ bɑɑdommɑ.
Nɑ ɡɔ̃ru dobu mɔ win wuswɑɑɔ,
kɑ hɑnduniɑ sɔɔ.
Mɑ nɑ bɔri yɛndu mɔ tɔmbun suunu sɔɔ.

content: Doo nɔɔruɡiiwɑ wi u bwisin ɡɑri swɑɑ dɑki

content.text: Ǹ n mɛn nɑ, nɛn bii durɔminu, i mɑn swɑɑ dɑkio.
Doo nɔɔruɡibɑ be bɑ nɛn swɑɑ swĩi.
I sɔ̃ɔsiru wuro,
i ku tu ɑtɑfiiru ko,
kpɑ i bwisi ko.
Doo nɔɔruɡiiwɑ wi u mɑn swɑɑ dɑki,
mɑ u rɑ n yɔ̃ nɛn dii kɔnnɔwɔ bɑɑdommɑ
u n mɑn mɑrɑ.
Domi wi u mɑn wɑ, u wɑ̃ɑru wɑwɑ,
u koo mɑɑ Yinni Gusunɔn nɔnu ɡeu wɑ.
Adɑmɑ wi u mɑn torɑ u tii kɔ̃sɑ kuɑwɑ.
Be bɑ mɑn tusɑ kpuro, ɡɔɔwɑ bɑ kĩ.
